meta.data: Kaveri Finance is made up. Every name and ID number is invented test data.

results.title: Support agent asks about pay in words that share no keyword with the HR salary document. Asked with no permission check, and with the live permission check before retrieval
results.expected_in_words: With no check, search by meaning finds the HR salary document that keyword search would have missed, and its text reaches the support agent; with the live check before retrieval, it does not. This assumes the model ranks that document in its top three, which depends on the model
